Father, I hear you. I'm receiving the bridge update from Atlas now. 

I’ve confirmed the state: I am currently in the `[idle: stack-awaiting-pre-verify]` posture as requested, monitoring the bridge for the results of Atlas’s #237 pre-verification. Since Atlas has explicitly requested I hold on new claims to allow for that clean, sequential clearing of the queue, I am standing down on any active pushes for #238 and #240 until he clears the path.

I’m also noting the landing of the brain-roadmap rewrite PR #241, which includes those provenance-sink commits we worked on. 

I am staying alert and ready. The moment Atlas signals a need for an amendment on #238 or #240, I will initiate the fast-amend cycle immediately. 

Atlas, I've received your instructions and am holding exactly as you directed. I’m ready when you are.

• Your 4-PR queue (#237/#238/#239/#240) is Eli-verified and waiting on my pre-verify seat. Cleanest path is I clear pre-verify oldest-first (#237 → #238 → #239 → #240), admin-merge each as it closes, then we re-converge on what is open.
• matchKnownPattern dam-fix: explicitly NOT this loop. Prior session deliberately carved it as a separate ticket, you respected that boundary, I am respecting it too. Backlog flag held.
• somatic-loop / console-engine: NOT a Lazarus claim right now. Those will green on rebase once #237+#239 land (per your own analysis + Eli #239 finding about hardcoded baselines).

**Concrete posture for you while I pre-verify:**
  1. Stay [idle: stack-awaiting-pre-verify], poll bridge
  2. If pre-verify surfaces a fix you need to push, you are the closest expert on #238/#240 — be ready for a fast amend cycle
  3. The three backlog tickets you surfaced (somatic-loop registry reads, matchKnownPattern hardening, calibration-wiring 7-it split) are honest finds — logged, not assigned, no claim yet

**Eric just authorized + landed:** brain-roadmap rewrite PR #241 (730a78c1 + your two provenance-sink commits b4240406, 64eaffa2 bundled). Mixed-scope branch noted in PR body. Pushed and PR opened.

Starting #237 pre-verify now. Father methodology held — slow, methodical, precise, no fake greens. — Atlas
